t: The Coal Generator is a simple early FE generator. Insert coal or coal blocks and it will burn them into power for nearby machines or connected cables.
煤发电机是一种简易的早期FE发电机。插入煤炭或煤块后，它将燃烧这些燃料，为附近机器或已连接线缆提供电力。
It has an internal buffer, so it can keep burning while output is temporarily blocked. Coal blocks are convenient for longer unattended runs.
它具有内部缓冲区，因此即使输出暂时被阻塞，也能持续燃烧。煤炭方块便于长时间无人值守运行。
